translations.web: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
translations.bsb: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
translations.kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
translations.asv: And while they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and the door was shut.
